data_fields.donor_constant: 4.0 in the command example; per link

data_fields.name: tether stiffness
data_fields.donor_constant: 50000 x pull factor, times dt (no damping)

best_idea: Taming needs no roll here: a consumable collar used next to a wild creature takes the nearest eligible one within a short radius if the owner is under a fixed pet cap, and the new pet is tuned to stay close and wake less easily.
decision_why: Take the instant, capped, radius-and-nearest tame and the pet tuning as catalogue data; move the donor's code-only eligibility list into data; do not port the tether spring as a companion leash because it has no damping and pulls the leader too.
acceptance: A server test: with 3 owned companions a collar use is refused and the collar is kept; with 2 owned and a wild wolf 4.9 tiles away that wolf becomes owned and the collar is consumed; a dragon within 5 tiles is never chosen; the owned companion has idle wander 0.25 and aggro range 0.25.
